findings.title: Missing Essential HTTP Security Headers
findings.impact: Exposes users to clickjacking, cross-site scripting (XSS), and protocol downgrade attacks.
findings.remediation: Implement missing security headers on web server or CDN: Content-Security-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy.

findings.title: Unenforced HTTPS Encryption (No Automatic Redirect)
findings.impact: Unencrypted HTTP traffic allows man-in-the-middle (MITM) eavesdropping and session hijacking.
findings.remediation: Configure 301 redirect from HTTP to HTTPS in server configuration.
